summary: Jaro-Winkler unconditionally applied a common-prefix boost, inflating similarities when the underlying Jaro score was at most 0.7. The fix applies the boost only above 0.7. The upstream test updated by this fix expects approximately 0.452 for "Friedrich Nietzsche" and "Fran-Paul Sartre", whereas the parent implementation returns approximately 0.562. Both implementation regions occur exactly once in their respective revisions. No tests were executed.
